scope: Proposition 4.17 (The continuation family) of the manuscript “The nonmaximal anti-de Sitter Penrose Inequality and original-data rigidity” (preprints/The-nonmaximal-anti-de-Sitter-Penrose-Inequality-and-original-data-rigidity-October-5-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 260 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 9e2b9ba2768918dc), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 49. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is a continuous piecewise smooth family, with parameter ξ ∈ [0, 4], starting at Equations (4.18), (4.19), and (4.23), and ending at the zero trace solution and scalar equation with zero source and inner flux. In the first three stages the source is the Ξ just defined, always evaluated using the current trace F. Every trace right side has derivative at least one in h, at fixed point, Z, and df. The outer values remain f = Z = 0.
